text: {"lessons":["Taking a gain feels satisfying, but I should not sell just to lock in a profit; I should weigh the stock’s prospects and risk of selling too early.","I should judge each holding as part of my overall portfolio, not let the separate-account feeling make me cling to a losing position or overlook concentration.","My average cost is not a reason to hold or sell; I should use a consistent plan based on current information and portfolio risk."]}
